data.title: Loopsy - Crochet & Knitting
data.description:
Loopsy is the all-in-one pattern and stash manager with built-in stitch and row counters for knitting, crochet, and every craft in between. With Loopsy you’ll never lose track of your progress, whether you’re on round 45 of a granny square or navigating a complex cable chart. It combines the precision of a knitting row counter and crochet stitch counter with smart tools that turn any PDF or website into an interactive guide.

Why crafters love Loopsy
• Built-in Counters & Progress Tracking – keep perfect count of rows, rounds, stitches, and repeats, no pocket notebook required
• Stash Management – catalog every skein of yarn, weight, and color in one place so you always know what’s on hand
• Discover & Save – browse thousands of free and premium patterns and tap once to save them to your collection
• Session Logging – track time and milestones, set goals, and build a consistent crafting habit

Whether you’re a beginner following your first pattern or an expert who needs a knit companion for intricate charts, Loopsy makes every project a breeze. Start crafting smarter today.

Ready to turn chaos into cozy? Get Loopsy now and start stitching smarter.

Terms & Conditions (EULA) and Privacy Policy: loopsy.com/terms
Support: support@loopsy.com
data.release_notes:
You asked, we delivered. Here’s what’s new:

- Turn Your Pattern Sideways: Turn your iPhone sideways in Work Mode for a wider view of your pattern. Move the floating counters to either side or tuck them away to keep your pattern in view.
- Craft Without the Clock: Turn off Session Timer when creating or editing a project to craft without watching the clock. You can still log time spent when you finish a session.
- A Smoother Loopsy: Enjoy smoother loading, better scrolling in Community, and crash and bug fixes throughout Loopsy.

Have feedback or need help? Reach us at support@loopsy.com. Happy crafting!
